data_fields.name: spawn_pick
data_fields.donor_constant: uniform random index among free candidate cells

data_fields.name: no_free_cell_rule
data_fields.donor_constant: entry dropped (no else branch, expires anyway)

data_fields.name: snapshot_before_kill
data_fields.donor_constant: unit data snapshot taken before the kill

best_idea: When a creature dies, queue a snapshot with a timer; when the timer fires the server places it on a random free spawn cell, and (our change) keeps it queued if none is free.
decision_why: The queue-then-place-on-the-server shape fits zone respawn (row 23), but the donor uses a one-card-turn timer and silently drops the unit when no cell is free; Frankendom needs seconds from zone data and a retry.
acceptance: A server test: a creature killed in zone Z with respawn_s = R reappears at one free spawn anchor after R seconds, only on the server tick; with every anchor occupied or the cap reached, no spawn occurs and the entry stays queued until a slot frees.
